overview_description.description: NG.CASH is a digital bank designed to help the new generations (ages 12 to 30) achieve financial independence. It lets users take charge of their money through solutions like PIX (Brazil’s instant-payment system), prepaid and virtual cards, allowance management, and now credit products tailored for young adults. As a financial hub, NG.CASH is built to grow with its clients, boosting financial literacy and supporting them at every stage of life.

product.name: Digital Account with Card and Pix
product.description: A digital bank account offering a personalized Mastercard prepaid card and Pix payment capabilities for sending and receiving money instantly.

product.name: Pix via WhatsApp
product.description: A service allowing users to send and receive Pix payments through WhatsApp messages, audio, and images.

product.name: Savings Jar (Cofrinho)
product.description: A digital savings feature that allows users to set aside money and earn monthly returns.

product.name: Payment Initiation Service
product.description: A service enabling users to initiate payment transactions through NG.CASH in partnership with Banco BTG Pactual, following Open Finance standards.

product.name: Chinelo Pay
product.description: A wearable payment device in the form of a sandal that enables instant payments with LED confirmation and tracking via the NG.CASH app.
